newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Point Beach nuke remains shut.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Point Beach nuke remains shut.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co said its 485 megawatt Point Beach 1 nuclear unit is still shut despite earlier reports that the unit would return to service last weekend.
"The unit remains in hot shutdown. We have a problem with the operability of one emergency diesel generator that would provide backup power to the plant," company spokeswoman Jackie Olson said.
Operators are investigating possible design changes to rectify the problem, she said.
No anticipated restart date was yet available.
The Point Beach unit, in Two Rivers, Wisc., was shut Feb 18 to repair a cooling system pump.
The adjacent unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, is scheduled to restart around April 12 following a refueling outage that began last October.
Wisconsin Electric is a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
